sign: Salt town on a dried lake. Do not walk past the white line. The line moves.
West: Mirror Flats. North: the Sunfall Terraces. East: the Lantern Span. South: the Salt Rift.

lines: Brine Healer Odo: A salt bath cures everything. Except debt. That needs the other kind of bath.
Salt Merchant Imke: Tonics, salt and silence. The silence costs the most.

lines: Salt Raker Bertil: I rake salt from dawn to dusk. Sometimes the rake finds a boot. Sometimes the boot is still full.
Widow Maren: My husband walked on the mirror and never came back. Halloran sent a bill for the salt he displaced.
Ferryman Ivo: There's been no water to ferry for twenty years. I still charge. Habit.
Solveig: Father says the white line moved again last night. He says it like the line is coming for dinner.
Bath Attendant Jost: Soak as long as you like. The brine takes the ache out. It took my brother out entirely.
Exchange Clerk Runa: We trade in salt and tonics. Salt keeps things from going bad. It has not worked on Halloran.

lines: Debt Scribe Almut: Every grain of salt is owed to somebody. I keep the book.
Debt Scribe Almut: The book is thicker than the lake was deep.
